The .sav's only value label (selfesteem1: 1='not at all', 4='always') agrees. DIRECTION CHECK (reverse-printed items stored already scored, i.e. as the key says): per-item counts in the .sav match the live table cell for cell (44/44, e.g. se3 7/22/51/125, selfesteem11 6/21/48/131; 9 = missing code dropped); the stored-value person mean 3.18 (SD 0.42) reproduces the paper's Table 2 3.19 +/- 0.42 (raw-storage reading would give 2.46); the five reverse-printed items' stored mean correlates +0.237 with the same respondents' spousal-support mean and -0.332 with pregnancy-stress (s001.sav), and the stored total gives +0.265 / -0.210 against the paper's Table 3 +.263 / -.180 (raw-storage reading: -0.050 / +0.212). SOURCE DISCREPANCY: the paper reports Cronbach's alpha 0.75 for this scale; the stored values give 0.64, and 0.76 only if the five reverse-printed items are flipped -- which contradicts the paper's own mean and correlations above. Treated as an error in the paper's alpha, not in the data. KEYING NOTE: se8 'I would like to have more self-respect' is keyed positive by this study (1-2-3-4) although the Rosenberg original keys it reversed; within the scale it correlates +0.21..+0.38 with the other positive items, but externally it runs with LOW self-esteem (r -0.133 with spousal support, +0.194 with pregnancy stress). Shipped per the study's key; flagged in public_note. TRANSCRIPTION: verbatim from s002 including the source's 'at much' (for 'as much') and 'somone'; the one deviation is se8's 'self-respect', where the PDF renders the hyphen as the glyph U+A813 ('selfꠓrespect', same artifact in 'situꠓation' on p.2) -- shipped as an ASCII hyphen. ' numbering stripped; the block header reads 'Self-esteem' and the instrument name adds the paper's attribution (PPP; Curry, Campbell & Christian 1994; Kim 2000). Nationality: Vietnam 159 (77.2%), Philippines 29, China 10, other 8. Recoverability check: the only supplements are s001.sav (English variable/value labels, no Korean/Vietnamese/Chinese text) and s002.pdf (English only; the non-ASCII characters are bullets, circled numerals and the hyphen glyph -- zero Hangul/CJK/Vietnamese diacritics). So language lists all five, base fields hold s002, no _translated columns, text_source=study_materials, per the szameitat_2015_* precedent. RIGHTS: no block. No rights-holder clause for the PPP was located; a Turkish validation study reports obtaining permission from Dr. Linda Bullock (rights transferred from Curry), which is a study's account of a courtesy request, not a quotable restriction from the holder -- silence is permission. Wording taken from the study's own CC BY 4.0 supplement. No register row written. STEP 3b: matches -- 11 live items on 1-4 = the paper's 11-item PPP self-esteem scale, 4-point 'not at all'..'always'.
